# swarmops ws materialize

Write out more of a workspace's tree: the paths join its prefixes.

The .gitignore and .swarmignore files of the directories above each path join too. A path the tree lacks joins as it is, nothing written, when it is on disk and its parent is the root, a directory of the tree or one above a prefix: a new file the hint of E\_WS\_OUTSIDE\_PREFIXES names. Else it is E\_PATH\_NOT\_FOUND.

## Syntax

```text
swarmops ws materialize [OPTIONS] <PATH>...
```

## Required arguments

### `PATH`

Syntax: `<PATH>`.

The repository paths to write out.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--ws`

Syntax: `--ws <NAME>`.

The workspace, by its name in the store's registry (default: the one around the working directory).

### `--ws-path`

Syntax: `--ws-path <DIR>`.

The workspace's directory.

### `--status-after`

Syntax: `--status-after <STATUS_AFTER>`.
Default: `page`.

page: the first page of the status follows the result; none: it is left out. Values: `page`: The first page of the status; `none`: No status.

## Return information

`result` is a `WsMaterializeResp` (`swarmops schema WsMaterializeResp` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bytes` | `integer` | yes | How many bytes were written. |
| `materialized` | `array of string` | yes | The prefixes added. |
| `status_after` | `WsStatus or null` | no | The status after the mutation; omitted when the request said `none`. |

Envelope `op`: `ws_materialize`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.
